What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.
* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man7/EVP_KDF-HKDF.pod and EVP_KDF-PBKDF2.pod state no constant-time property.

The default of `pbkdf2`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
